content: {"praised":["Classic Danielle Steel movie brings emotional tears and joy.","Melissa Gilbert delivers strong acting despite accent issues.","Story offers safe, loving atmosphere for viewers.","Good love story with heartfelt forgiveness.","Characters like Brad Johnson and young girl add warmth."],"criticized":["French accent is terrible and distracting.","Melissa Gilbert looks unlovable and overdone.","Story is dull romance, waste of time.","Leading man is boring and unattractive.","Badly dyed hair and poor pacing."]}
